notes.title: Ancestors Legacy on Xbox Series X
notes.content:
[b]Any next-gen owners here? [/b]

We have some good news for you - Ancestors Legacy for Xbox Series X is now available and includes:

[list]
[*] much faster loading and more fluent play thanks to higher FPS rate
[*] better look thanks to the Auto HDR and 4K
[*] cross-gen multiplayer!
[/list]

So now you can grab your brand new controller and conquer a few villages.

Any of you have already launched Ancestors Legacy on the X? How was it?

notes.title: Mod support is here + 66 % OFF!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28748587/2fb15e21c35bd77825854a457fa22c747430aaa7.png[/img]

Greeting conquerors,

The day you’ve all been waiting for has arrived. [b]Steam Mod Support is finally here![/b] We know it took a while, but we really wanted to provide you with something special and truly big in terms of what you can create. However, we’re still not done and plan to keep on improving Mod Support. That's why we’re calling this Beta for now. To give you even a bigger reason to get Ancestors Legacy, we are also running a [b]66 % discount![/b]

With Mod Support, there are many things that you can modify and add to the base game:
[list]
[*] Maps
[*] Characters
[*] Animations
[*] Game balance
[*] Modifying nations
[*] Audio
[*] Buildings 
[*] And much more
[/list]

For more detailed information about Mod Support and how to get started creating your own content, please head over here:

https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/18446744073709551615/1639794651176609093/?appid=620590

Be aware that the below subjects are not tolerated and mods containing such content will be removed:
[list]
[*] Racism
[*] Hate speech
[*] Meaningless violence
[*] Intolerance of religion and beliefs
[/list]
 
Find this information and more in the EULA.

We also released dedicated servers available for everyone that owns Ancestors Legacy, which you can find in the tools section.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/620590/discussions/0/3175526477765701812/

tags.feature: Steam Mod Support is finally here!

notes.title: Glory to the Heroes!
notes.content:
A brand new update just landed on Steam!
Heroes joined Multiplayer duels and this is what they bring to the game:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/034c6f41fe2d7079c5b2603b001c421fd557519b.jpg[/img]

Heroes are squads containing of a single pawn, which doesn’t have a morale bar, and so, doesn’t suffer from morale loss. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/b96c61ff65d1173d691863a62aecb32ab356df8b.jpg[/img]

On the other hand, Heroes have special aura indicated by big blue circle around them, which, once players food drop to zero, prevents other squads morale loss from hunger. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/46c2a237fe5ec25307f260caf7e8a4d32454f20c.jpg[/img]

Heroes cannot be replenished or re-recruited when they die.

Haven’t registered for the tournament yet? No worries, you still have time as epic battles will start on August 25 th .
Follow this link: https://battlefy.com/the-overpowered-noobs/ancestors-legacy-medieval-clash-of-swords-supported-by-amd-powered-by-opnoobs-esports-4indie/5b6355f1cae55603af211eca/info?infoTab=details for all the details and apply today for a chance to win your very own,
powerful AMD Ryzen CPU and Ancestors Legacy Collector’s Edition!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/66a6dc2a77be3d482f7bff19d41622633673e898.jpg[/img]

Patch Notes:
- Added heroes in multiplayer games -  they are on by default, but you can turn them off in while setting up multiplayer/skirmish game
- Added system for reporting players
- Added spectators info on MP loading screen
- Spectators can now turn on Action Camera - simply by pressing Action Camera key while cursor is hovering over squad
- Some fixes to AI logic
- Arrow Rain ability can be used now when movement is blocked.
- Fixed poorly looking warehouse in mission "Holmgard"
- Some improvements in catapult movement
- Dedicated server will now refresh themself every few hours. This way they will avoid going into blocked state after spending too much time in idle
- Proper clearing game data when player try to join other game from endscreen
- Some fixes to pop ups shown after Alt+F4
- Fixed issue with taking ownership of base when squad is inside - rerecruit did not work correctly in this case
- Fixed issue with banners colours and player name when AI took over for player who leave game
- Few weird crashes fixed

notes.title: New features, new maps and tons of improvements, fixes and balancing!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/6677848b0b00021258f5c10893f94985241407a0.jpg[/img]

Hi Conquerors,

your voices were heard! We know how much you liked the [b]Autumn Rise[/b] map from the Multiplayer Beta so we decided to bring it back together with one completely new map called [b]The Capital of Evil[/b] (2v2)!

We also implemented a new feature that you requested and that is the [b]Tactical Pause[/b]!

With that we are introducing a lot of improvements, fixes and balancing! Check the changelog below that lists the most important changes:

GENERAL
- Feature: Tactical Pause.
- Depth of Field, Chromatic Aberration - these graphical settings now work properly.
- Public matches against AI now give profile experience. Also, bugfixes for timeouts resulting in a loss.
- Viking Scouts are now three-man squads (previously - two).
- Cycling through squads now available on Keyboard & Mouse (TAB).
- Lots of performance, stability and gameplay fixes.
- Many fixes in localizations. Added Japanese language support, and Brazilian Portuguese is on the way.
- Upgrading your nation to Tech Tier II now costs 50% less resources.
- Fixed many issues with recruitment for single-player AI.
- Dismissing a squad now gives you part of the resources back.

MULTIPLAYER
- New map: The Capital of Evil (2v2). The MP Beta map is back: Autumn Rise.
- When hosting a game, the match settings are saved from previous session.
- Added the tech timeline for other players in match summary.
- Time limit is now off (unlimited) by default in Domination Mode.
- Tons of tweaks and rebalance on multiplayer maps.

Full changelog here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/620590/discussions/0/1618346571420818671/?ctp=2

notes.title: Community update. Well, sort of...
notes.content:
Hey folks!
In case you're wondering, we're still working hard on improving Ancestors Legacy. A reasonably big update is heading your way, hopefully still in June, so I wanted to take this opportunity and somewhat tease its contents:
[list][*]The work on dedicated servers for the game is going good - we'd like to set them up still this month, should gods be with us.
[*]We have an idea how to let more of you try out the game before you decide to give us your hard earned money. Something similar to our pre-launch open beta, but not exactly...
[*]Our community deserves all the best, so we work restlessly to bring you a fully professional tournament. It will take much more than a free weekend and couple passionate community members to do it this time around. Bear with us.
[*]We have our eyes and minds focused on much more cool stuff we can expand the game with, like workshop support, new features and/or modes? But that's top secret stuff for now, only in properly labelled documents stored deep in our armored vaults![/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/7433901936c4b5951cffb7eaac4537f5836c11fe.jpg[/img]

Oh, and the image? It's a totally random screenshot from some dedicated server stress-tests that we did yesterday. It was... inspiring.

tags.feature: The work on dedicated servers for the game is going good - we'd like to set them up still this month, should gods be with us.
We have an idea how to let more of you try out the game before you decide to give us your hard earned money. Something similar to our pre-launch open beta, but not exactly...

Our community deserves all the best, so we work restlessly to bring you a fully professional tournament. It will take much more than a free weekend and couple passionate community members to do it this time around. Bear with us.

We have our eyes and minds focused on much more cool stuff we can expand the game with, like workshop support, new features and/or modes? But that's top secret stuff for now, only in properly labelled documents stored deep in our armored vaults!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Ancestors Legacy Multiplayer Beta is LIVE
notes.content:
We will send out the Steam keys to EVERYONE who registered and confirmed the e-mail address through our beta sign up page: http://destructivecreations.pl/beta

Also, we've seen many people play the beta already through the weekend. Thanks to everyone who shared the impressions, either by streaming, posting a video, using the feedback/bug forms available from the game's main menu, or even sending a crash report. It helps a lot!
We are going to patch the beta in a day or two. The most important tweaks:
- Additional AI difficulties.
- The match starts automatically after a short delay, when the map is loaded.
- When the player waits too long for a Quick Match, he/she will automatically host a listen server.

Bear in mind that we do not have dedicated servers, so creating your own server raises your chances for successful matchmaking drastically.
Last but not least, due to the game's complexity and complete lack of tutorials in our multiplayer mode, it's highly advisable to at least browse the Manual. You can find it in the game's main menu, or here: https://doc.destructivecreations.pl/AL_MP_Beta_Guide_Dec2017.pdf

See you in the battlefield!

UPDATE: We've decided to prolong the key giveaway and we will be sending keys to everyone who signed up already and to anyone who signs up till the end of Friday 15.12.2017 23:59 CET.
